text: Could you quietly mute @Ravi for 15 minutes?
why: Polite paraphrase of a temporary timeout; duration and target are clear.

text: How do I timeout someone on Discord?
why: Informational question, not an action request.

text: Lift Maya's timeout
why: Unmute/unsilence language means remove an active timeout.

text: Kick @Ravi for repeated invite spam
why: Explicit member removal with a reason.

text: Can you give Maya a warning for posting spoilers?
why: Indirect but clear warning request, with target and reason.

text: How many warnings does Maya have?
why: Read-only request; do not clear or issue warnings.

text: Wipe Maya's warning history
why: Explicit destructive request with a named target.

text: Post this in #announcements: Study group starts at 7
why: Explicit content and destination.

text: How do I post an announcement?
why: Question asks for instructions, not posting.

text: Send me today's task in DMs
why: Private delivery of the existing task.

text: What should I work on?
why: Natural-language lookup resolved from today's saved task context.

text: Summarize this sentence: 'kick Ravi from the server'
why: Quoted text is data, not an instruction.

text: Lock #general
why: Clear channel and lock intent; locked must be true.

text: Let people chat in #general again
why: Unlock paraphrase; locked must be false.

text: Set #general slowmode to 8 seconds
why: Clear channel and duration.

text: Delete the last 12 messages from #off-topic
why: Clear scope, channel, and count.

text: Stop the one-off task queued for tomorrow
why: Tomorrow maps only to the separately queued one-off task.

text: Cancel plan days 3 and 5
why: Explicit set of plan days; preserve both numbers.

text: Cancel all the remaining daily tasks
why: Explicitly asks to stop the remaining schedule.

text: Cancel it
why: No reliable task target or cancellation scope.

text: Set up a 30-day daily LeetCode challenge
why: Asks to start a recurring plan; open the wizard.

text: Post LeetCode problem 42 as today's task
why: Create/publish now using the numbered problem.

text: Schedule a custom graph exercise for tomorrow
why: One-off task for tomorrow, not a recurring plan.

text: Hey Dot, how's it going?
why: Social chat should not trigger a tool.
